items.title: Implement the core main write lock primitive
items.context: Per session-ownership-and-write-leases.md Main Write Lock Rules 1-3 & 6: a global, atomic (mkdir-style), stale-reclaimable lock; lock scope covers the whole critical section; acquisition failure is blocking (no optimistic proceed). Reconcile storage with the existing .koala/runtime/done-main-merge.lock — decide and document migrate vs alias vs compatibility (the F-001 open decision), keeping story-lifecycle.md and session-ownership-and-write-leases.md synchronized.

happy.desc: main write lock 在 .koala/locks/main-write.lock/ 成功 acquire+release，mkdir-style 原子
全仓 rg 旧 .koala/runtime/done-main-merge.lock 路径 0 残留引用（除非测试证明的兼容 alias）

edge.desc: stale 锁（mtime 超时）被正确 reclaim
锁被持有时 acquire 失败返回 blocking 错误、不乐观放行

adversarial.desc: 两个并发 acquire 恰好一个成功，无双重持锁
story-lifecycle.md 与 session-ownership 文档锁路径一致，无两份真相源矛盾

items.title: Hold the lock across the DONE critical section and fix F-008
items.context: DONE must hold the main write lock from the pre-merge final check through merge and worktree cleanup (rule 4). Fix B-META-framework-audit:F-008: the DONE flow currently writes a stale INIT_CHECK-era main-mirror story index.json before merge, then its own git merge aborts (partial-DONE). The fix must handle the stale main-mirror inside the lock — do not emit a stale mirror, or commit/reconcile it before merge — because serialization alone does not close F-008.

happy.desc: DONE 全程持 main write lock（pre-merge gate→merge→worktree cleanup 都在锁内）
正常单 session DONE 成功路径外部行为不变

edge.desc: F-008 复现场景：DONE 前 main 工作区有 INIT_CHECK 期未提交 index.json 镜像 → DONE 不再自阻塞、正常合并
INIT_CHECK 不再留下未提交的 main-side index.json 镜像

adversarial.desc: 两个并发 story_advance DONE 被锁串行化，无 partial-DONE race
post-merge 失败语义保持：story 已 DONE + 显式抛错

items.title: Apply the lock + in-lock idempotency to shared-write commands
items.context: Apply the main write lock to gap_log / B-META finding writes / audit --framework / story_create / done_recover / main-mirror metadata writes (rule 5). Inside the lock, perform the doc's Idempotency Requirements: gap_log dedup by normalized title/category/source/evidence fingerprint; story_create dedup; finding mutations reject duplicate active findings; DONE recovery detects already-merged branches / already-removed worktrees.

items.title: doctor stuck-lock check and lock-contention error UX
items.context: doctor detects stale/stuck main write locks and reports them. Lock-contention produces a clear blocking error message per the doc's Error UX 'main lock contention' example (holder session, running command, heartbeat age, retry guidance). Do NOT implement session_brief ownership rendering — that belongs to the owner-lease story.

items.title: Multi-session regression smoke proving F-008 is closed
items.context: Smoke tests for multi-session lock behavior: two concurrent DONE operations serialize with no partial-DONE race; concurrent gap_log of the same issue dedups to one canonical finding; a stale lock is reclaimed. Critically, a regression assertion proving partial-DONE no longer arises from a stale main-mirror self-block (the exact F-008 scenario).
